meta.description: Lunar 24 canonical machine registry — source of truth for DSP/UI/MIDI/serialization/tests. P0 vertical-slice dataset (oscillator, normalized jack route, effector program). Identity is order-independent: every serialized enum entity carries an explicit immutable numeric id. Evidence refs point to design/reference/solar42N_manual_text.txt line numbers.

modules.name: VCO A
modules.description: AS3340 triangle-core VCO, 6 waveforms (2 morphing). Mirrors VCO B except VCO A has a SYNC input.

modules.name: VCO B
modules.description: AS3340 VCO, mirrors VCO A except VCO B has a VCO output and VCO A's output is normalised to its CV input (CV AMT knob).

modules.name: Dual 12dB Polivoks VCF
modules.description: Dual 12dB Polivoks LP/BP filter. Product behavior spec: raising resonance does NOT lose lows. CV L is normally connected to CV R (CV L controls both channels when CV R has no signal).

modules.name: Sensor keyboard
modules.description: 12 capacitively-sensitive touch plates with VOLT/octave, gate, pressure and clock outputs. Larger subsystem; P0 captures the normalized-route evidence only.

modules.name: Envelope A
modules.description: ADSR envelope + hold, gate in, VCA CV. P0 captures gate-normalized-route evidence.

modules.name: Envelope B
modules.description: ADSR envelope + hold, gate in, VCA CV (mirror of Envelope A). P0 captures gate-normalized-route evidence.

modules.name: LFO A
modules.description: Dual LFO A: square<->triangle wave mix, rate, speed multiplier. P0 captures the patchable cv_out (nominal 0..+10V).

modules.name: LFO B
modules.description: Dual LFO B: square<->triangle wave mix, rate, speed multiplier. P0 captures the patchable cv_out (nominal 0..+10V).

modules.name: Joystick
modules.description: Position-locking joystick: X/Y axes + two voltage offset regulators -> two patchable CV outputs (nominal -10..+10V). P0 captures the panel state params as software-normalized placeholders and the two bipolar CV outputs.

modules.name: Preamp
modules.description: Contact-mic preamplifier: a software-normalized gain placeholder (unit norm 0..1) plus one external audio input. The internal mic_in/audio_out endpoints defer to the FixedEndpoint stage.

modules.name: Envelope follower
modules.description: Envelope follower: software-normalized attack/release placeholders (unit norm 0..1) driving an envelope CV output (0..+10V) and a gate output (0..+8V). The internal audio_in endpoint defers to the FixedEndpoint stage.

modules.name: 5-step sequencer
modules.description: 5-stage sequential voltage source: an internal clock (PULSER) with an external clock/trigger input, a STAGES selector for 3/4/5 steps, and five continuously adjustable step-CV outputs (0..+5V) plus five step-gate switches (off/on), a CLOCK OUT, and a CV/GATE out. Voltage/polarity/coupling on the clock jacks is not documented (kept unknown/unverified); CV/GATE outputs carry the legend ranges.

modules.name: Voice mixer
modules.description: Panoramic stereo mixer feeding all device audio: 10 input channels, each with a PAN pot and a VOL pot. Channel order (manual L1112): ch1 DRONE 1, ch2 DRONE 2, ch3 DRONE 3, ch4 EXT. AUDIO, ch5 VCO A, ch6 VCO B, ch7 PREAMP, ch8 DRONE 4, ch9 DRONE 5, ch10 DRONE 6. PAN/VOL are software-normalized 0..1 placeholders; the manual gives no taper / dB law / center / default, so all six fieldEvidence are unverified (PAN is not -1..1, VOL is not a linear-gain claim). mixer *_in/out are internal endpoints and are not represented as patchable jacks.

normalizedRoutes.description: By default the keyboard V/OCT output is normalised to the Volt/octave input of VCO A (VCO B is normalised analogously; only VCO A's sink is captured in this P0 slice). Plugging a cable into the sink overrides it.
By default GATE LEFT (MAIN) is normalised to the gate input of the envelope generators controlling the VCO A/B VCAs.
CV L is normally connected to CV R. CV L controls both channels if there is no CV-signal in CV R. Plugging into CV R overrides this.

By default the keyboard V/OCT output is also normalised to the Volt/octave input of VCO B (the analog of route.keyboard_v_oct_to_vco which captures VCO A's sink). Plugging a cable into the sink overrides it.
VCO B-region vco_b.vco_out carries the VCO A normalised signal into vco_b.cv_in; CV AMT sets the depth.
By default GATE LEFT (MAIN) is also normalised to the gate input of Envelope B (the analog of route.keyboard_gate_to_eg which captures Envelope A's sink). Plugging a cable into the sink overrides it.
